subject: ctfBackfillParticipation is a deployed callable with ZERO callers
description: Found by Wes while writing the tournament runbook, independently confirmed: exports.ctfBackfillParticipation at functions/index.js:8388 is a real deployed onCall that grants the Competitor badge to students already placed on a roster by an admin, and NOTHING invokes it - no console button, no _tools script, no other function. Its sibling ctfAwardTournamentBadges (placements) does have a button (console.html:11873). Same defect class as 406 (verifyDiscordLinkCode): deployed, unreachable, and nothing holds it in agreement with the path that actually runs. Consequence: admin-placed roster members silently never receive the join badge, and the function that exists to fix that cannot be run. Either wire it to a button in the Manage panel or archive it - but not leave it deployed and unreachable.
activeForm: Working on: ctfBackfillParticipation is a deployed callable with ZERO callers
